purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for Universal Module substrates, Domain compositions, bindings, ownership and closure findings.

owns: Universal Module and Domain Monitor semantics

topics.name: Universal Module and Domain Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for Universal Module substrates, Domain compositions, bindings, ownership and closure findings.

semantics.identity_rule: Module, Domain, binding and semantic-owner identities remain exact/separate.
semantics.graph_rule: Visual composition graph is projection only; edges correspond to explicit composition/binding refs.
semantics.action_rule: Create/edit binding/domain/module operations invoke separate authorized canonical editors/operations.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing composition does not grant runtime/edit authority.
semantics.trace_rule: Displayed resolved Domain semantics retain substrate owner/source refs.
semantics.redaction_rule: Restricted configuration/details are redacted according to policy.

invariants.rule: Universal Modules are reusable substrates and Domains are explicit compositions of those substrates plus domain-specific deltas; composition never duplicates substrate ownership.

hard_gates.condition: resolved semantic loses substrate owner trace

prose.summary: Define a read-only Expose monitor for Universal Module substrates, Domain compositions, bindings, ownership and closure findings.
